d: Meanwhile, as the US-Iran war enters its sixth month, the biggest question may be one Washington still cannot answer: What does Donald Trump actually want from Tehran? Trump says preventing an Iranian nuclear weapon remains his “number one goal.” But Vice President JD Vance has recently placed cheaper oil and gas prices at the top of his list, alongside denuclearization. Meanwhile, reports suggest tensions with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over the war’s military costs and strategy. The shifting objectives have fueled questions about whether Trump’s administration has a coherent endgame.…
